description: Check whether .eth names can be registered and what they cost, e.g. 'Is alice.eth available?'. Takes up to 50 names; available ones come with their price for the duration (1 year by default), including any premium on a recently expired name. For who holds a taken name, use get_name_details; to register one, use register_name.

paymentToken.description: Token to pay with: usdc (default) or dai
